node.statement: Put delta:=c0*epsilon. Since U is a nonempty subset of the atomic index set of the supplied partition state for the same map w:C^m->A, choose j in U; its atomic basis vector e_j in C^m is nonzero. The assumed extended delta-inclusion property of w, at amplification n=1, gives the two-sided norm bounds (1-delta)||e_j|| <= ||w(e_j)|| <= (1+delta)||e_j||. Comparing the endpoints and dividing by 2||e_j||>0 gives delta>=0. Thus 0<=c0*epsilon follows locally from the assumed inclusion, without using node 1.2.
